student_task:
Help Maya prepare her classroom's art supplies.

Maya needs to share 24 pencils equally among 6 students so everyone can begin drawing.

| Pencils | Students |
|---|---|
| 24 | 6 |

Calculation: 24 / 6.

Use 24 divided by 6 to calculate each student's share. Write the number of pencils per student and one sentence explaining the division. Do not use another method.
